claudeCode: In Claude Code, read [the Claude Code adapter](../../docs/harness/claude-code.md) once per session before you follow this skill. It maps the Cursor names in pstack skills to Claude Code.

To run another nstack skill that this file names, read `../<name>/SKILL.md` next to this skill's folder and follow it. The Skill tool refuses nstack skills. When you tell the user to type one, write `/nstack:<name>`.
Set `model` to that line's value, or to the default if the rule or the line is missing.
Set `model` and `effort` from that line's value, or from the default if the rule or the line is missing. A value such as `opus xhigh` means `model: "opus"` and `effort: "xhigh"`.
Pick each subagent's reasoning level and fast or standard speed for the job
Pick each subagent's reasoning level (`effort`) for the job
If it rejects the default, use the closest valid slug of the same family from its error message.
If it rejects the default, omit `model` so the agent runs on the parent model, and say so.
**create-skill** skill (Cursor's built-in for authoring SKILL.md files)

`skill-creator` skill (Anthropic's skill for authoring SKILL.md files. When the session does not list it, write the SKILL.md by hand with `name` and `description` frontmatter, a description that says when to use it, and a body that tells the agent what to do)
